source.text: Party D (a financial buyer) submitted an LOI to acquire the Company for a price of $21.00 per share (subject to a four-week diligence period).

financing.instructions: For Party D at "late July 2016 LOI", what does the supplied source explicitly report about financing commitment? Judge only financing; do not import another bidder or date, or infer commitment from all-cash consideration.

criteria.committed: Financing commitment provided, capital expressly committed, or financing not needed.
criteria.missing: Explicitly no firm commitment, uncommitted financing, or financing contingency.
criteria.silent: No explicit statement establishing either commitment or absence for this bidder at this event. Silence is not missing financing.
